data.body: DEFENSE_RECORD: {"finding_id": "f-h8i9j0k1", "defense_text": "Cosmetic. The grep pattern 'PR comment deferred: *\\\\t' is intentional: the dso test stub uses printf '\\t%s' to emit tab-delimited log lines, so a literal-backslash-t pattern would never match. The negative assertion documents 'no bare-title regression' even if the pattern under-matches; the new test_defer_title_falls_back_on_empty_slug provides the strict positive coverage with grep -F.", "severity_history": [{"cycle": 1, "severity": "minor"}]}
